APPNIVA · FRIENDS ALPHA

Turn an idea into an app.

Appniva uses AI to turn a plain-language idea, checklist, or guide into a small web app. Open it from its own link or add it to your phone’s Home Screen. No app store download is needed.

The signup link is a placeholder while the official form is being prepared.

Get an invite · Make an app · Install on iPhone · Install on Android

1. Request and open your invite

  1. When the signup form is ready, use it to request access. If you’re invited, you’ll receive a unique, single-use invite link.
  2. Open the full invite link in the browser where you want to use Appniva. Tap Join Appniva to open your workspace. The browser flow doesn’t require a password.
  3. Keep the invite link to yourself. If it’s expired or already used and you can’t get back into your workspace, contact the person who invited you.

2. Describe what your app should do

  1. In Your idea, describe one task. For an idea, say what someone should be able to do. For a checklist, include the items and what should happen when they’re checked. For a guide, paste the steps in order and say how readers should move through them.
  2. Be specific about what should be saved or reset. For example, “Make a weekend packing checklist grouped by clothing, toiletries, and gear. Let me add items, remember what I’ve checked on this phone, and clear the checkmarks before the next trip.”
  3. Tap Make my app. When it’s ready, tap Open your app and try the main actions. Check any generated instructions before relying on them or sharing them.

3. Open, save, or share your app link

Your generated app has its own URL, separate from your invite. Bookmark it, find it later under My Apps in your signed-in browser, or use Share app to send it to someone. Anyone with the app URL can open it.

Install on iPhone with Safari

  1. Open the generated app URL in Safari. If it opened inside another app, copy the URL into Safari.
  2. Tap Share. Depending on your Safari layout, you may need to open the page menu first.
  3. Choose Add to Home Screen. If it’s missing, look under Edit Actions in the Share menu.
  4. Turn on Open as Web App if shown, then tap Add. Open the app from its new Home Screen icon.

Apple’s web app instructions

Install on Android with Chrome

  1. Open the generated app URL in Chrome.
  2. Tap the three-dot menu. Look for Add to Home screen or Install and create shortcut, then choose Install if offered.
  3. Follow the prompt and open the app from its new icon. If Chrome only offers Create shortcut, use it to add a Home Screen link that opens in Chrome.

Google’s web app instructions

Alpha limits and privacy

  • The browser alpha allows one successful app creation per invitee and up to 2,000 characters per prompt. Start with a small, self-contained task.
  • Appniva sends your prompt to OpenAI to generate the app. Leave out passwords, personal information, and confidential material. Since app links are public, keep sensitive content out of the app itself as well.
  • If your app saves progress, that data stays in local browser storage. It doesn’t sync across devices, and clearing site data can erase it. Open the app online first and test it before counting on offline access.
